data.name: AMazeing Racer
data.detailed_description:
# AMazeing Racer: From Scrap to Legend

AMazeing Racer drops you into a sprawling urban maze where every run is a fresh challenge against the clock. Navigate through a dynamic grid of city blocks with your customizable ride, master the art of drifting, and climb the ranks of an underground racing league.

KEY FEATURES:

# MASTER THE MAZE

  • Procedurally Generated Challenges - Every race reshuffles the city's layout while maintaining a familiar backdrop

  • Time Trial Intensity - Beat the countdown timer to unlock new districts and earn bigger rewards

  • Drift-Based Scoring - Tear through corners with style to maximize your cash rewards

# BUILD YOUR LEGEND

  • 100-Level Campaign - Journey from rookie to legend through increasingly complex mazes and challenges

  • Golden Engine Questline - Collect rare parts to assemble the mythical Golden Engine across your racing career

  • Boss Battles - Face off against league bosses in unique race scenarios with special objectives

# CUSTOMIZE YOUR RIDE

  • Diverse Vehicle Lineup - Unlock different car classes with unique handling characteristics

  • Performance Upgrades - Enhance your car's acceleration, handling, and unlock nitro boost capabilities

  • Visual Customization - Personalize your ride with paint jobs, decals, neon underglows, and audio packs

# COMPETE AND CHALLENGE

  • Daily Maze Challenges - Take on daily pre-seeded layouts with global leaderboards

  • Weekly Drift Gauntlet - Test your skills in a massive 7-level challenge combining previous daily tracks

  • Random Level Mode - Race through procedurally generated mazes for endless replayability

data.short_description: Race through ever-changing urban mazes in AMazeing Racer! Master the art of navigation while customize your vehicles, go from a struggling driver to racing legend as you assemble the mythical Golden Engine. Every run is different, every corner a challenge, and every drift brings you closer to glory.

pc_requirements.minimum:
Minimum:
  • OS: Windows 10 (64-bit)
  • Processor: Intel i3-6100 / AMD Ryzen 3 1200
  • Memory: 6 MB RAM
  • Graphics: NVIDIA GTX 750 Ti / AMD R7 360
  • DirectX: Version 11
  • Network: Broadband Internet connection
  • Storage: 10 GB available space
  • Sound Card: DirectX-compatible sound card
  • VR Support: Not required; optional support via OpenXR
  • Additional Notes: Designed for low-poly visuals and scalable performance.
